title: Concept: One-time code returned in the response
description: The one-time code that was just issued for the step-up check in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The code is the second factor, so returning it in the same response as the request removes the factor entirely and lets anyone holding the session complete the step-up.
applicability: Deployments that render the one-time code that was just issued for the step-up check into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The code is the second factor, so returning it in the same response as the request removes the factor entirely and lets anyone holding the session complete the step-up.
